name: Callback Desk - live path (Worker intake, staff approval, Google Calendar)

parameters.content:
## Callback Desk live path
Worker intake: the Cloudflare Worker posts verified Twilio events here (Header Auth).
Staff decision: staff approve a request revision and a time; only then does the calendar node run.
Pending requests: staff list what is waiting.
No node sends a message. Drafts wait in static data for staff.
Bind every REPLACE_* credential and the calendar id after import.

parameters.jsCode:
const store = $getWorkflowStaticData('global');
return [{ json: { items: Object.values(store.items || {}).filter(i => ['pending_staff', 'calendar_pending', 'calendar_failed'].includes(i.status) || i.drafts.some(d => d.status === 'needs_staff_approval')) } }];
